title: Finding with Optional
description:
Look things up without `null`.

```
findUser("ada") -> Ada Lovelace
findUser("zed") -> unknown user
email of "bob" -> no email
email of "ada" -> ADA@EXAMPLE.COM
```
requirements: `Optional<User> findUser(String id)` and `Optional<String> email()` on the user.
Chain with `map`, `flatMap`, `filter` and `orElse`; no `isPresent()` followed by `get()`.
`record User(String id, String name, String email)`, where email may be `null` inside the record.
stretch: Add `Optional<User> manager()` and find a user's manager's email in one chain.
